rows.note: 1.5 GPa and 80 um at 970 kg/m3 are the 011b pin. They are not a candidate allowable.
Pillow radius is set to the bay side, 2.04 m, because that is the 011b film formula. It is not a measured cap.
Where no creep-rupture fraction was opened, the design stress is half the opened ultimate. Kapton, Teonex and Vectran use it.

rows.state: exists as a filament test note
rows.note: The 19 year life is Toyobo's extrapolation of an HM filament at 60 percent of break, not a laminate test.
A uniaxial filament needs a 0/90 build to carry both pillow directions. Total thickness is twice the one-direction thickness. No resin is included, so a real laminate is heavier.
The 20 percent fraction and the 15 and 250 year lives are indicative rope numbers at 16 C, not a film.
Density is the printed GPa divided by the printed N/tex. The sheet does not print density.
The design thickness is above the 250 um row. The 210 MPa ultimate is the thickest opened gauge, not a measurement at the design thickness.
The IEC Teonex sheet says its typical values are not design data.
The barrier brochure has no PET strength, modulus, density or creep. The 12 um mass is not computed.
The oxygen column does not print the test pressure. The scale uses 1 atm of oxygen.
N2 is opened for Kapton only. PEN, Mylar and the ALD paper do not give N2.
The case has no exterior humidity. Water loads stay at the sheet condition and are not a hull rate.
The alumina numbers are coupon measurements. A 1257 m2 hull coating was not opened. Tagged PROJECTION at hull scale.
No getter capacity is stated. The pump band is the 150 to 400 kg catalog class, not scaled to the gas load.
No production allowable was opened. Thickness is not stated.
A filament crossply is not taken as gas-tight. The barrier is a separate layer.
Dry-air mole fractions 0.20946 and 0.78084 are not in the vacuum case.
